title: Public Alert No. 043/2026-NAFDAC Places Products Marketed by Mofus Nigeria Ltd on Watchlist Pending Regulatory Investigation
summary: NAFDAC has placed products marketed by Mofus Nigeria Ltd (MAH) — linked to Ayrtons Saunders Ltd, UK and manufacturer Pharmaserve (North West) Ltd — on its watchlist pending investigation (ref NAFDAC/PMS/2026/0029) over regulatory non-compliance and possible misrepresentation.
